name: 21-wireguard
teaches: The wireguard block without a privilege: `drt wg keygen` and `drt wg pubkey` are the key pair, so setting up a peer never needs wireguard-tools; `drt wg check` says whether a config can work without touching the interface, including the case that otherwise fails silently -- an allowed_ips no route will reach. 22-wireguard-interface is the half that creates the interface.
